en.headline: Extremely hot start to the work week, showers possible midweek
en.dek: The Observatory expects mainly fine and extremely hot conditions through Tuesday under residual influence from Typhoon Dolphin, with temperatures easing slightly and isolated showers arriving later in the week.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the outer subsiding air associated with Severe Typhoon Dolphin will keep southern China generally fine early this week, bringing extremely hot weather to Hong Kong.

On Monday and Tuesday, conditions are forecast to remain mainly fine with daytime temperatures reaching 34 to 35 degrees Celsius in urban areas and higher in parts of the New Territories. The Very Hot Weather Warning is expected to stay in force.

A southwesterly airstream is expected to affect the Guangdong coast from midweek. High temperatures will continue but isolated showers may develop later on Tuesday and on Wednesday, with sunny periods and one or two showers through Thursday.

Towards the end of the week the weather is forecast to become mainly cloudy with a few showers and sunny intervals, and maximum temperatures around 32 degrees. Members of the public are advised to continue taking heat precautions, drink plenty of water and avoid prolonged outdoor exposure during the hottest hours.

zh.headline: 下周初極端酷熱 中期或有驟雨
zh.dek: 天文台預料強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響下，本周初大致天晴極端酷熱，周中起西南氣流影響，氣溫稍降並可能有局部驟雨。
body: 香港天文台表示，強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流將令華南早期大致天晴，本港持續極端酷熱。
周一及周二預料大致天晴，日間市區氣溫約34至35度，新界部分地區更高，酷熱天氣警告料繼續生效。
周中起西南氣流影響廣東沿岸，高溫持續但周二稍後及周三局部地區可能有驟雨，周四則間中有陽光及一兩陣驟雨。
周末前天氣轉為多雲，有幾陣驟雨及陽光，最高氣溫約32度。市民應繼續防暑，多喝水，避免在最炎熱時段長時間戶外活動。
